_comment: Provenance for the recorded Portkey Admin API fixtures used by contract tests. Regenerate with `PORTKEY_API_KEY=... npm run record:fixtures`, which rewrites this file and stamps recordedAt. The contract suite asserts this list stays in sync with tests/fixtures/responses/.
liveCaptureStatus: The configured credential returned HTTP 403 for organisation users, API-key creation, and Secret Reference list/create on 2026-07-14. On 2026-08-27, rate-limit, usage-limit, and MCP-integration lists were captured successfully; the hosted deployments route returned the data-plane HTTP 400 missing-provider response, while analytics and usage-limit-entity fixtures remain documentation-derived. The audit-logs-list fixture is derived from the published AuditLogObjectList schema in Portkey-AI/openapi (GET /audit-logs is Enterprise-gated and the configured credential gets a permissions error, so it was never captured live). The collections-list and collections-get fixtures are derived from the published CollectionWithDetails and CollectionWithChildCollections schemas in Portkey-AI/openapi, covering nested collections (parent_collection_id, child_collections), and were not captured live.
